extracted.intended_audience: media organizations and Department of War public affairs/visual information professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and service features for distributing military media (press releases, video, images, print) via the DVIDS/DWIA platform to journalists, broadcasters, and the public. Covers availability, content quality, distribution channels, archive and accessibility expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: accurate, reliable source
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide an accurate, reliable source for media organizations to access U.S. service members and commanders deployed in support of military operations worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DVIDS's core objective is accuracy and reliability when connecting media with deployed personnel and commanders; content and services should support that mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: 24/7 operation / continual availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Is a state-of-the-art, 24/7 operation owned by DWIA that provides a timely, accurate and reliable connection between the media around the world and the military serving at home and abroad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services and distribution are expected to be continuously available to support fast-breaking news and ongoing media needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time broadcast-quality media
rubrics_metrics.description: Through a network of portable Ku-band satellite transmitters’ located in-theater, robust IP connections, and a distribution hub DVIDS makes available real-time broadcast-quality video, still images and print products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content provided via DVIDS should meet broadcast-quality standards and be available in real-time for immediate use by media outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate interview opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides immediate interview opportunities with service members, commanders and subject matter experts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DVIDS should facilitate rapid access to interview subjects directly involved in events to enable timely, first-hand reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timely delivery via internet and satellite
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides requested products to media organizations in a timely manner via internet distribution and satellite broadcasts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribution workflows should prioritize fast turnaround and multiple delivery paths (internet and satellite) to meet media deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for embedded storytellers
rubrics_metrics.description: Allows embedded storytellers to transmit broadcast-quality video from the field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tools and processes must enable personnel embedded with units to create and transmit journalistic-grade media from operational environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable archival access
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintains a searchable archive of video, photo, print and audio products for interested media and military communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content should be archived with metadata and search functionality so media and stakeholders can find past assets easily.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customized alerts and subscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Delivers customized subscription emails and text alerts instantly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systems should support subscriber-specific notifications to push relevant content to journalists and stakeholders immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-platform distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Makes content available on a variety of external platforms including social media channels, apps and podcasts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content strategy and formatting should accommodate distribution across multiple platforms and formats to maximize reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility / 508 compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: New DVIDS Tool Achieves 508 Compliance for Military Units.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tools and published content should meet accessibility standards (Section 508) so military units and audiences with disabilities can access materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for smaller/local markets
rubrics_metrics.description: Allows smaller markets to routinely report on local units when deployed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distribution and asset access should enable local media (smaller markets) to cover their deployed local units regularly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Live high-definition streaming capability
rubrics_metrics.description: DVIDS premiers HD live from Afghanistan during Super Bowl XLV on FOX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform capabilities include live HD streaming for major events; distribution and technical standards should support live, high-definition broadcasts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordination of special programming (holiday greetings, events)
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinates holiday greetings and special event programming from deployed Soldiers, Sailors, Airmen and Marines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The service organizes and distributes themed or event-specific programming for morale and media use; processes should support coordination and delivery of such programming.
